title: Full Stack Engineer - Go, React, Javascript, Java-Springboot

* Support and maintain tools for deployment, monitoring, and operations

* Optimize application performance, scalability, and security
* Stay current with emerging technologies and propose adoption wherever beneficial

* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements.

* 6+ years of professional experience in software development
* Hands-on experience in cloud platforms (Azure preferred, AWS/GCP acceptable)

* Solid experience with front-end technologies: Templ with Go, HTML5, Java Springboot, JavaScript, and frameworks like React

title: Modeling & Simulation Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Location NANAKRAMGUDA, HYDERABAD, India Category Engineering Job Id R000161635 Job Type Full time Entry Level

  

**Job Location**

HYDERABAD OFFICE APAC PSC GDOP

**Job Description**

P&G was founded over 180 years ago as a simple soap and candle company. Today, we're the world’s largest consumer goods company and home to iconic, trusted brands that make life a little bit easier in small but meaningful ways. We've spanned three centuries thanks to three simple ideas: leadership, innovation and citizenship. The insight, innovation and passion of hardworking teams have helped us grow into a global company that is governed responsibly and ethically, that is open and visible, and that supports good causes and protects the environment. This is a place where you can be proud to work and do something that matters.

**Dedication from Us:** You'll be at the core of breakthrough innovations, be given exciting assignments, lead initiatives, and take ownership and responsibility, in creative workspaces where new insights thrive. All the while, you'll receive outstanding training to help you become a leader in your field. It is not just about what you'll do, but how you'll feel: encouraged, valued, purposeful, challenged, heard, and inspired.

**What we Offer:** Continuous mentorship – you will collaborate with peers and receive both formal training as well as day-to-day mentoring from your manager dynamic and encouraging work environment– employees are at the centre, we value every individual and support initiative, promoting agility and work/life balance.

**Job Description**: Do you like to apply Modeling & Simulation (M&S) and Machine Learning (ML) concepts in the development and optimization of high-speed manufacturing processes (virtual manufacturing) in the consumer goods industry? Do you like to solve manufacturing challenges? How would you like to turn on your creative genius and problem-solving to develop Digital Twins for virtual qualification, optimization of current manufacturing processes and predicting future state and design next generation autonomous manufacturing systems that deliver superior quality products and packages for consumers? If this sounds like fun, we are looking for someone with your skills and abilities.

As an M&S + ML Engineer, you will use modern data analysis and ML approaches in combination with engineering first principles in different fields such as Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, metallurgical etc and physical data to help us to develop and understand complex manufacturing systems. This work is foundational to developing Digital Twins for virtual qualification and real time manufacturing and warehouse optimization. You will also develop fast surrogate models of complex engineering processes that will require the combination of Advanced M&S tools of Finite Element Analysis, Computational Fluid Dynamics, Production System Modeling with ML and physical data. You will be working with a highly talented cross-functional team of R&D scientists and engineers with expertise in R&D, manufacturing processes and data infrastructure. You will also Balance in-house development against turnkey solutions with best-in-class partners and own the build/buy recommendation and the technical due diligence behind it.

This role has a unique ability to use the power of ML in combination with M&S to deliver insights and drive end to end thinking starting from raw material to manufacturing processes to final product as delivered to our consumers. Ultimately you will be turning insights derived from ML + M&S into actionable recommendations that drive business value.

**Job Qualifications**

We are seeking individuals with a master’s or PhD degree in an engineering discipline and demonstrated practical experience and/or publications applying artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) in combination with engineering principles to solve complex engineering problems. Candidates with advanced degrees in computer science, statistics, applied mathematics, or a related quantitative field may also be considered, provided they have demonstrated practical experience and/or publications applying AI/ML to engineering problems.

If you are a good fit for the M&S + ML Engineer role, you will have:

* Strong foundation in any branch of Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, Material Science, Electrical, Metallurgical, Aerospace etc)
* Hands on coding experience and mastery in one or more languages (Python, R, C++), knowledge in either Python or R is required.
* Experience using AI-assisted software development tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to develop, test, and document engineering applications
* Demonstrated expertise in analysis of large data sets (“big data”) to deliver actionable insights from data
* Demonstrated expertise in combining first principles concepts/science in any field of engineering with advanced ML approaches to develop surrogate models
* Prior experience and/or strong interest in “real world” problems. This includes knowledge of manufacturing processes and data infrastructure.
* Strong communication skills. The candidate is the link between “incomprehensible” data and engineers who need to act on new insights. This requires both, listening skills to understand the problem to help with, as well as ability to build trust, explain context, and potential solutions.
* Our manufacturing platforms are running on Integrated Control Systems. Interest or experience in these will also be a plus

Preferred Specialties/Area of Research:

* ML, including Deep Learning
* Engineering background with ML specialization &/or research publications
* Data Mining (such as data preparation, regression, classification tools, SVM)
* Optimization (global, local, stochastic methods)
* Model Reduction, Dimensionality Reduction
* Data bases and data processing

Preferred Experience with Analytical Tools/Applications:

* Unix/Linux
* Scientific Computing: R, Python, C++, Java, Scala
* Deep Learning frameworks: Keras, TensorFlow
* High-Performance Parallel and Distributing Computing (CPU and GPU)
* Data Visualization
* Data Management Systems

**About us**

We produce globally recognized brands, and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders are able to lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head & Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.

Visit http://www.pg.com to know more.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, HIV/AIDS status, or any other legally protected factor.

***At P&G, the hiring journey is personalized every step of the way, thereby ensuring equal opportunities for all, with a strong foundation of Ethics & Corporate Responsibility guiding everything we do.***

***All the available job opportunities are posted either on our website - pgcareers.com, or on our official social media pages, for the convenience of prospective candidates, and do not require them to pay any kind of fees towards their application.”***

Full time

R000161635

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**About Simplismart**

Simplismart is a GenAI inference platform to deploy, scale, and monitor any GenAI model (LLMs, speech, vision, or diffusion) across cloud or on-prem. Built for strict SLAs, enterprise-grade security, and full observability. Its modular design lets you optimize for cost or latency or auto-select the best topology per workload.

**Role Overview**

In this role, you will design and build the high-level architecture of Simplismart’s MLOps platform from the ground up, enabling scalable, reliable, and GPU-accelerated ML workflows across the product ecosystem.

**What is expected from you-**

* Design and implement the core architecture of a next-generation MLOps platform capable of running diverse GPU-accelerated workloads at scale.
* Formalise and standardize heterogeneous ML workloads—including LLM/VLM/ASR/diffusion pipelines and build orchestration abstractions for them.
* Build internal systems for continuous deployment of services, modules, and model pipelines across multi-cloud and hybrid environments.
* Create frameworks for high reliability, observability, and fault-tolerance for mission-critical inference, training, and data pipelines.
* Collaborate closely with Applied ML and Core ML teams to improve system reliability, latency, and cost efficiency.
* Develop internal tooling to benchmark, evaluate, and deploy models quickly and consistently.
* Ship production-grade code and infrastructure using strong engineering fundamentals and test-driven development (TDD), aligning with Simplismart’s engineering culture.
* Troubleshoot complex systems, performance bottlenecks, GPU behavior, and distributed workloads.

**What We’re Looking For-**

* Deep technical expertise in system design, distributed systems, and GPU-based ML workloads.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals (data structures, APIs, testing, debugging).
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* Strong knowledge of ML fundamentals, model architectures (Transformers, CNNs), and inference behavior.
* Ability to build, maintain, and reason about multi-step pipelines (ETL → model → evaluation → deploy).
* Strong systems knowledge: Linux internals, networking, performance tuning, GPU memory behavior.
* Ability to work independently, own large ambiguous problems, and collaborate across teams.
* Excellent communication skills—able to articulate design decisions, tradeoffs, and system impacts clearly.

**Good to Have-**

* Experience with modern inference stacks such as TensorRT, Triton, vLLM/TGI, SGLang.
* Exposure to quantization, model optimization, or CUDA concepts.
* Hands-on experience with Llama/Mistral, Whisper, or Stable Diffusion pipelines.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, Docker, GitHub workflows, and IaC-driven deployments.
* Experience designing high-availability or fault-tolerant production systems.

**Why Join Simplismart?**

* Opportunity to define and lead the brand identity of a fast-growing GenAI company.
* Work closely with leadership on high-impact initiatives from global event campaigns to overall storytelling.
* Be part of a team that values design as a strategic lever, not just execution.
* Competitive compensation and growth opportunities in a high-energy startup environment.

answers.Cover Letter:
Dear Hiring Team at Simplismart,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Machine Learning Engineer role at Simplismart. As a final-year Computer Science student and Computer Vision Engineer with hands-on experience in real-time 3D perception, sensor fusion, and edge-optimized model deployment, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to Simplismart's GenAI inference platform. Your focus on deploying, scaling, and monitoring GenAI models across cloud or on-prem aligns perfectly with my background in optimizing models for latency and cost using TensorRT, ONNX, and quantization techniques.

In my current role as a Machine Learning Engineer at Mayonix Innovation, I have trained and evaluated object detection models (YOLOv8, YOLOv9) achieving 92%+ mAP, built image-embedding-based recommendation systems, and developed on-device computer vision features using TensorFlow Lite and MobileNetV3-Small. I have optimized models through INT8/FP16 quantization, structured pruning, and GPU delegate configuration to achieve sub-100ms inference latency on edge devices. title: Lead Technical Support Engineer
description:
**About Simplismart**

Simplismart is a GenAI inference platform to deploy, scale, and monitor any GenAI model (LLMs, speech, vision, or diffusion) across cloud or on-prem. Built for strict SLAs, enterprise-grade security, and full observability. Its modular design lets you optimize for cost or latency or auto-select the best topology per workload.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Technical Support Engineer with a strong focus on MLOps to provide enterprise-level assistance to our customers. In this role, you will diagnose and troubleshoot issues related to machine learning models, frameworks, and deployment pipelines. Your goal will be to ensure the seamless operation of ML systems and to assist our clients in leveraging these technologies effectively.

**What is expected from you-**

* Ownership of Issues: Take ownership of customer issues related to machine learning applications and see problems through to resolution.
* Research and Diagnosis: Research, diagnose, troubleshoot, and identify solutions for software and hardware issues specifically related to machine learning environments.
* Technical Support: Provide support for ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) and tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow) used in model training and deployment.
* Network Configuration: Assist clients with network configuration issues that may affect ML model performance and data access.
* Remote Support: Use remote desktop connections to provide immediate support and guidance to clients facing technical challenges in their ML workflows.
* Communication: Communicate effectively via email, chat, and phone to provide clear instructions and technical manuals to clients.
* Collaboration: Work closely with the Customer Success Manager and data science teams to ensure seamless support and integration of ML solutions.
* Escalation: Properly escalate unresolved issues to appropriate internal teams, such as data scientists or software developers, when necessary.
* Documentation: Document technical knowledge in the form of notes and manuals, particularly focusing on MLOps best practices and troubleshooting steps.
* Follow-Up: Ensure all issues are properly logged and follow up with clients to confirm their ML systems are fully functional post-troubleshooting.

**What We’re Looking For-**

* Proven Experience: Demonstrated experience as a Technical Support Engineer, MLOps Engineer, or similar role with a focus on machine learning technologies.
* Hands-On Experience: Proficiency with ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) and familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) for ML deployment.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues related to ML model performance, data pipelines, and infrastructure.
* Remote Desktop Applications: Familiarity with remote desktop applications and help desk software (e.g., Freshdesk) for efficient support delivery.
* Problem-Solving Skills: Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in simple terms.
* Educational Background: BS degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Science, or a relevant field.
* Certifications: Additional certifications in machine learning, cloud computing, or relevant technologies (e.g., AWS Certified Machine Learning, Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer) are a plus.

**Why Join Simplismart?**

* Opportunity to define and lead the brand identity of a fast-growing GenAI company.
* Work closely with leadership on high-impact initiatives from global event campaigns to overall storytelling.
* Be part of a team that values design as a strategic lever, not just execution.
* Competitive compensation and growth opportunities in a high-energy startup environment.
